components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action control: firm, bright, and immediately legible.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #FF4D00; border-radius: 16px; background: #FF4D00; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 15px 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: opacity 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.8; transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF4D00; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet but reliable bordered action for secondary choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #3D3B38; border-radius: 16px; background: #252422; color: #F0ECE8; font: 600 15px 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: opacity 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #8F8A85; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.8; transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF4D00; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A compact tonal field whose border carries focus and validation state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #F0ECE8; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; } .ds-input { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #3D3B38; border-radius: 12px; background: #252422; color: #F0ECE8; font: 400 15px 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #8F8A85; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #FF4D00; }

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: A compact selection control with a decisive filled active state.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #3D3B38; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(26, 25, 23, 0.5); color: #8F8A85; font: 500 13px 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: opacity 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-chip-active { border-color: #FF4D00; background: #FF4D00; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF4D00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workout Card
components.description: A flat, bordered workout container with compact operational hierarchy.
components.html:
Push Day4 exercises

Bench Press · Shoulder Press · Triceps
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #3D3B38; border-radius: 12px; background: #252422; color: #F0ECE8; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-card strong { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card span, .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #8F8A85; font-size: 13px; } .ds-card:focus-within { border-color: #FF4D00; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Equal-width compact modes on a tonal track with a quiet sliding selection.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: #252422; } .ds-segment { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #8F8A85; font: 500 15px 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, opacity 120ms ease; } .ds-segment-active { background: #3D3B38; color: #F0ECE8; } .ds-segment:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-segment:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF4D00; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Three thumb-reachable destinations with a compact orange active pill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); min-height: 66px; padding: 8px 12px 10px; border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0; background: #252422; } .ds-nav-item { display: grid; justify-items: center; align-content: start; gap: 2px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #8F8A85; font: 600 10px 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-icon { display: grid; width: 48px; height: 34px; place-items: center; border-radius: 16px; transition: background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-nav svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-active { color: #FF4D00; } .ds-nav-active .ds-nav-icon { background: rgba(255, 77, 0, 0.12); } .ds-nav-item:active .ds-nav-icon { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF4D00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Snackbar
components.description: Transient feedback with a restrained float and a slim orange status rail.
components.css: .ds-snackbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #3D3B38; border-radius: 16px; background: #2E2C2A; color: #F0ECE8; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); font: 500 15px 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-snackbar-rail { width: 6px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; background: #FF4D00; } .ds-snackbar strong { flex: 1; font-weight: 500; } .ds-snackbar button { min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #FF4D00; font: 600 13px 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-snackbar button:hover { opacity: 0.82; } .ds-snackbar button:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-snackbar button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF4D00; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
LiftLog is a calm, distraction-free environment for serious training. Its visual system behaves like premium gym equipment: dependable, responsive, and purpose-built. Warm industrial neutrals create a quiet field while Ignition Orange marks decisive action, active state, and progress.

Polish reinforces momentum, confidence, and fast decision-making rather than entertainment. The interface stays tactile and athletic without becoming loud; it is restrained enough to disappear during a set and precise enough to earn trust under repeated use.
keyCharacteristics: Focused, tactile, athletic, calm, and confident.
Structurally flat, with depth carried by tone, contrast, spacing, and borders.
Compact enough for fast operation, but never cramped or fragile.
Responsive motion and feedback that confirm action without delaying it.
Native-aware behavior shared coherently across iOS and Android.

rules.name: The Orange Is Action Rule
rules.body: Ignition Orange must communicate action, selection, focus, or meaningful progress; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Tonal Structure Rule
rules.body: Separate hierarchy with warm surface steps and subtle borders before reaching for shadow.

rules.name: The Instrument Readout Rule
rules.body: Oversized numerals belong only to live measurements such as elapsed time, countdowns, or step totals.

rules.name: The Weight Before Size Rule
rules.body: Prefer an established weight or role before inventing a new text size.

rules.name: The Training-Reach Rule
rules.body: Primary workout actions live where they are easy to reach one-handed and never depend on precision tapping.

rules.name: The Four-Point Rhythm Rule
rules.body: New spacing should resolve to the existing four-point cadence unless a native inset or measured control requires otherwise.

rules.name: The Flat Until Floating Rule
rules.body: If an element does not physically or behaviorally float above the current task, it does not receive a shadow.

rules.name: The Functional Curve Rule
rules.body: Curvature must support grip, grouping, state, or safe touch geometry; it is not decoration.

dos: Do keep the common workout action immediate, thumb-reachable, and visually obvious.
Do use Ignition Orange only for action, selection, focus, or meaningful progress.
Do establish hierarchy through warm tonal surfaces, spacing, and subtle borders.
Do use short motion to confirm state changes while preserving a responsive feel.
Do adapt navigation, insets, touch targets, and system behavior to iOS and Android conventions.
Do keep advanced features visually subordinate until the user needs them.
donts: Don't use glossy fitness-marketing treatments, excessive gradients, glassmorphism, or neon palettes.
Don't add gamified, achievement-heavy, or entertainment-first decoration.
Don't turn every content group into an oversized card or every control into a pill.
Don't add shadows to ordinary resting surfaces.
Don't introduce generic corporate-wellness styling or lifestyle-brand imagery.
Don't let animation delay input, obscure state, or compete with the workout.
